The group formed at the Extreme Rules pay-per-view in May 2013 when James Harrison turned on tag team partner John Cena and came together with his long time tag team partner AJ Styles and opponents in that match The Young Bucks. Before they end of the year they were joined by Wade Barrett and Kenny Omega. Over the years the group continued to grow with the additions of Luke Gallows, Karl Anderson, Cesaro, Finn Bálor, Marty Scurll, Charlotte Flair and most recently Cody Rhodes.
